audioPolicy: Retain actual audio/custody references; no repeated WAV decoding or correctness audit.
clockPolicy: Pair host/process/recorder/clock/stage/handler/span/correlation; no cross-host subtraction or sum of independent quantiles.
failedAssistantEvidence: V1513 measured203/global716 completed STT then assistant transport failed; no TTS reached or strict failed assistant server-header ID. Raw provider candidates are not force-joined.
missingSpanPolicy: Missing saved-prefix spans describe coverage, not a model failure. The final failed ASSISTANT request has no client response server-correlation ID; do not force-join an adjacent provider completion by time or order.
